messages:
Jamie Nguyen: quick summary of the snapshot idea: precompute top-k route scores every 1s and apply tiny delta updates. sims show ~18% reduced decision latency variance, memory up ~12%.
Sara Patel: nice. what do snapshots contain? full vector or compressed top-k?
Jamie Nguyen: top-k + scores + last_updated_ts + epoch. we only recompute full scores on big signal shifts.
Pranav Iyer: consistency concern: if snapshots are 3s stale during a capacity spike could tenants miss SLOs?
Jamie Nguyen: safety net: fast-path live scoring when probes indicate capacity delta > threshold. snapshots are cache-only.
Lee Wong: control-plane bandwidth worries. are deltas per-region? how big?
Jamie Nguyen: deltas are tiny (route_id + float delta + epoch). typical 8-12 bytes per route, batched per-region/shard with backpressure. sample: route_id=r-123 delta=-0.08 epoch=171234
Maria Gomez: ops note: previously cached affinity caused transient preemptions when shards moved. need epoch binding to leases.
Jamie Nguyen: agreed. bind snapshots to node_lease_epoch. on lease change mark stale and run live probe before committing admission.
Sara Patel: what is the "soft-quota" check you mentioned offline?
Jamie Nguyen: runtime keeps a small live token pool (eg 5 tokens) for sudden surges. snapshot says accept but if live tokens exhausted, runtime hedges to fallback route or lower-cost variant.
Pranav Iyer: cold-start/new routes?
Jamie Nguyen: new routes use live scoring; we create snapshots for routes above qps threshold within initial window.
Lee Wong: telemetry/alerts? we need snapshot_age histogram, delta_ack_lag, and staleness_violation_count + dashboard.
Jamie Nguyen: will add those. also add a guardrail: if stash mismatch rate > X% disable snapshot path for region.
Maria Gomez: ops-bot can you schedule a resilience test: 10k tenants, frequent shard moves, mixed TTLs?
ops-bot: job rt-snap-2026-03-25 created, running in ~2h. results link in #eng-sre when complete.
Sara Patel: i'll review the runtime integration PR later today. :thumbsup:
Jamie Nguyen: next steps: PR for snapshot proto, runtime hook + fallback, SRE load test, and dashboard. will post links here.
